description: Add weak-light colony signs, a strong-torch signature reveal, and interactive fissure evidence without making grues combat actors.

replacements.new:
<ROUTINE GRUE-COLONY-REVEALED? ()
    <COND (<G? <GETP ,GRUE-FISSURES ,P?VALUE> 0> <RTRUE>)
          (T <RFALSE>)>>

<ROUTINE GRUE-COLONY-STRONG-LIGHT? ()
    <COND (<EQUAL? <META-LOC ,TORCH> ,HERE> <RTRUE>)
          (T <RFALSE>)>>

<ROUTINE GRUE-COLONY-REVEAL ()
    <COND (<NOT <G? <GETP ,GRUE-FISSURES ,P?VALUE> 0>>
           <PUTP ,GRUE-FISSURES ,P?VALUE 1>
           <TELL
"The flaming ivory torch drives light much farther into the cracks than the
ordinary glow did. Not one shadow but many pull away at once. Coal ticks
down several different fissures as separate movements retreat beyond the
firelight. Nothing stays illuminated long enough to show you a body, but the
pattern is unmistakable: this dead end borders a grue colony." CR>)
          (T
           <TELL
"The torch reaches into the fissures again. Several different patches of
darkness withdraw from its edge, each choosing a separate crack. The colony
stays beyond the strong light." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE GRUE-COLONY-ROOM-FCN (RARG)
    <COND (<EQUAL? .RARG ,M-LOOK>
           <TELL
"You have come to a dead end in the mine. The coal-dark wall is split by a
fan of narrow fissures too small for an adventurer." CR>
           <COND (<GRUE-COLONY-STRONG-LIGHT?>
                  <GRUE-COLONY-REVEAL>)
                 (<G? <GETP ,GRUE-FISSURES ,P?VALUE> 0>
                  <TELL
"Your present light is enough to keep the room usable, but not enough to
reach as deeply as the torch did. The fissures look empty only until you
notice that every small scrape begins just beyond the useful edge of light." CR>)
                 (T
                  <TELL
"At the edge of ordinary light, a scrape from one fissure is answered by a
second scrape somewhere else. Coal shifts, then becomes perfectly still." CR>)>
           <RTRUE>)>>

<ROUTINE GRUE-FISSURES-FCN ()
    <COND (<VERB? EXAMINE LOOK-INSIDE>
           <COND (<G? <GETP ,GRUE-FISSURES ,P?VALUE> 0>
                  <TELL
"The fissures are narrow black seams in the coal. Strong firelight proved
that many separate things can withdraw through them, but no grue obligingly
remains where it can be inspected." CR>)
                 (T
                  <TELL
"The cracks are too narrow to enter. Fine coal dust at several mouths has
been disturbed recently, though not in any single obvious direction." CR>)>)
          (<VERB? LISTEN>
           <COND (<G? <GETP ,GRUE-FISSURES ,P?VALUE> 0>
                  <TELL
"One soft scrape stops. A second answers from another fissure. A third does
not quite become a sound before it too goes still." CR>)
                 (T
                  <TELL
"For several seconds there is nothing. Then two faint scrapes answer each
other from different cracks." CR>)>)>>

<ROUTINE TORCH-OBJECT ()
    <COND (<VERB? EXAMINE>
